//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the INLINE code component. See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model. SCOPE NOTE: the shared dumpers (svelte scripts/fidelity/dump.mjs REGISTRY.code → display/Code.svelte; keen pa.fidelity.dump code → PureAdmin.Components.Code.code/1) render the INLINE <code> element, NOT the block-level pa-code <pre> or the pa-code-block header form. So this fixture is the contract for inline code only: a bare native <code> element with an optional class passthrough and slot content. The block/header forms (pa-code--*, pa-code-block__*) live in separate wrapper components (svelte CodeBlock/CodeBlockWithHeader, keen code_block/1) that the dumpers are not wired to, and are out of scope for this slice.

propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the <code> element (class passthrough — not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Inline code is the bare native element core blesses for inline code (snippets/code.html: `npm install`, no pa- class — the element itself is styled by the `code` type selector in _code.scss). No attribute conventions are added. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks structural nesting, not rich content. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away by the comparator; goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract for inline code. There is NO pa-code block class and NO pa-code--modifier on the inline element (those belong to the block <pre> form, a separate component out of scope here). `produces: null` = structural/native; the only outputs are the slot content and an optional class passthrough.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: Inline code is a bare `code` element selector with no BEM block/modifier classes, so there are no code--* classes in main.css for the axis-1 reverse check to claim.
